quizName: DMV Practice Test #3 25 Questions • Passing Score 21

questions.question: What is a good way to handle someone tailgating you?

options.text: Change lanes and let them pass.
Ignore them.
Use your horn and make rude gestures.
Speed up to create distance between you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes and let them pass.
questions.explanation: The safest way to handle a tailgater is to change lanes and let them pass. If you speed up, they may tailgate you at the higher speed, which increases danger.

questions.question: When your turn is obvious, should you use a turn signal?

options.text: No, you do not need one.
Yes, you should always use one.
Only if there are pedestrians nearby.
Only if you are at a traffic light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, you should always use one.
questions.explanation: Always use a turn signal when you turn or change lanes. Other vehicles may not see your intentions. There may be cars nearby that you do not notice.

questions.question: Can clothing help prevent injuries in a crash?

options.text: No, clothing does not protect you.
No, clothing is just a personal choice.
Yes, but only if clothing is very loose and flaps.
Yes, if a jacket and pants fully cover your arms and legs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, if a jacket and pants fully cover your arms and legs.
questions.explanation: Good clothing can reduce injury risk in a crash. Wear a jacket and pants made of sturdy material that fit snugly and do not flap in the wind.

questions.question: What should you do if someone is tailgating you?

options.text: Ride faster to shake them off.
Call the local police.
Ride on the road shoulder.
Let them pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let them pass.
questions.explanation: The safest way to handle a tailgater is to let them get ahead of you. Change lanes safely and let them pass. Riding faster may increase danger by making them tailgate at a higher speed.

questions.question: What kind of helmet gives the best protection?

options.text: One that fits snugly.
One that is well-worn and broken in.
One that is loose.
One without a chinstrap.

questions.correctAnswerText: One that fits snugly.
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) standards. It should fit snugly all around with no obvious damage.

questions.question: What role does clothing play when riding a motorcycle?

options.text: It should be loose enough to flap in the wind.
It should not fully cover your arms or legs.
You should not wear a jacket in warm weather.
It can protect you if you crash.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can protect you if you crash.
questions.explanation: Good clothing provides important protection in a crash. Wear a jacket and pants that fully cover your arms and legs, even in warm weather. Clothing should fit snugly without flapping but allow you to move freely.

questions.question: Before riding an unfamiliar motorcycle, what should you do?

options.text: Ride it like your own bike, since all bikes are the same.
Check the controls and gear shift pattern.
Trust the owner that everything works.
Assume you know where all controls are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check the controls and gear shift pattern.
questions.explanation: All motorcycles are different. Check the controls and learn the gear pattern before riding. Test the throttle, clutch, and brakes before you start.

questions.question: If you wait one hour after drinking one alcoholic drink, can you ride safely?

options.text: Yes, you cannot be arrested for drunk riding.
Yes, alcohol will not affect your riding.
No, alcohol may still affect you.
Yes, as long as you ride slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, alcohol may still affect you.
questions.explanation: Your body removes about one drink's worth of alcohol per hour. However, alcohol can still build up in your system and affect your riding ability.

questions.question: Which color clothing makes you easiest to see?

options.text: Orange
Black
Brown
Deep blue

questions.correctAnswerText: Orange
questions.explanation: Orange, red, yellow, or green clothing makes you more visible when riding. Always wear bright colors, no matter what time of day you ride.

questions.question: What are the rules when passing another vehicle?

options.text: You may exceed the speed limit to complete the pass.
You may ignore "No passing" markings if you started in a legal zone.
You may pass on the shoulder.
You must pass within the speed limit and in a legal passing zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must pass within the speed limit and in a legal passing zone.
questions.explanation: Always pass within posted speed limits. Only pass where it is safe and legal.

questions.question: Most crashes happen during the day. To be more visible, you should:

options.text: Wear bright-colored clothing.
Wear dark clothing.
Ride without your headlight.
Ride in a weaving pattern.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear bright-colored clothing.
questions.explanation: Since most crashes happen during the day, always wear bright-colored clothing when riding, even in daylight.

questions.question: Which item is NOT a good choice when choosing riding clothes?

options.text: A jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs completely
Boots or shoes that cover your ankles
Gloves made of leather
A baseball cap to cover your hair

questions.correctAnswerText: A baseball cap to cover your hair
questions.explanation: To protect yourself from injury, wear a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, a sturdy jacket and long pants, boots or shoes that cover and support your ankles, and durable gloves.

questions.question: Why is it dangerous to ride directly alongside another vehicle?

options.text: You may be in its blind spot.
It is distracting to have a vehicle next to you.
Other drivers may want to use the lane.
It would be hard to see what is behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may be in its blind spot.
questions.explanation: Riding directly alongside another vehicle is dangerous because the driver may not see you in their blind spot. The vehicle could also block your escape route if danger appears.

questions.question: You can increase your visibility by:

options.text: Adding extra lights to your motorcycle.
Not using your turn signal.
Wearing dark clothing.
Waving at people.

questions.correctAnswerText: Adding extra lights to your motorcycle.
questions.explanation: To increase visibility, wear bright or reflective clothing. You can also add extra lights to your motorcycle, use your turn signals, and flash your brake light when needed.

questions.question: If your footwear has laces, you should:

options.text: Tuck them in.
Let them hang loose.
Remove them from the footwear.
Glue them together.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tuck them in.
questions.explanation: Tuck laces in securely so they do not get caught on your motorcycle.

questions.question: The best gear to wear while riding is:

options.text: Any gear that helps protect you.
The cheapest gear.
Gear that looks good.
Any gear that fits.

questions.correctAnswerText: Any gear that helps protect you.
questions.explanation: Wear gear that protects you while riding. This includes a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, and protective clothing.

questions.question: When braking, you should use:

options.text: Only the front brake.
Only the rear brake.
Both brakes.
Either brake, but never both at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both brakes.
questions.explanation: Always use both brakes at the same time to stop. Both brakes are most effective when used together.

questions.question: A street-legal motorcycle should have all of the following EXCEPT:

options.text: A headlight, taillight, and brake light.
Two mirrors.
A flag.
A horn.

questions.correctAnswerText: A flag.
questions.explanation: A street-legal motorcycle must have a headlight, taillight, and brake light; front and rear brakes; turn signals; a horn; and two mirrors.

questions.question: A motorcycle fits you properly if:

options.text: You can touch your feet to the ground while sitting on it.
You can reach the controls by stretching.
The handlebars go over your head.
Your feet cannot rest on the foot pegs.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can touch your feet to the ground while sitting on it.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle fits you properly if your feet can reach the ground while you are sitting on it. You should be able to reach and operate the controls easily.

questions.question: A rectangular sign can be a:

options.text: School crossing sign.
Railroad crossing sign.
Stop sign.
Speed limit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed limit sign.
questions.explanation: Signs that show road rules, like speed limits, are usually rectangular with white backgrounds and black letters or symbols. You must follow the rules on these signs.

questions.question: Motorcycles have blind spots just like cars. When changing lanes, what should you do?

options.text: Turn your head and look over your shoulder to check your blind spot.
Look only at your mirrors.
Rely on your side vision.
Slow down so vehicles in your blind spot can pass you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder to check your blind spot.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see in your mirrors. Turn your head and look over your shoulder to check for vehicles before you change lanes.

questions.question: If you drink alcohol, what should you do?

options.text: Decide if you can ride safely based on how you feel after drinking.
Set a limit beforehand so you can still ride safely.
Do not ride.
Do not worry about your riding ability if you feel okay.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not ride.
questions.explanation: The safest choice is to not ride after drinking alcohol. Any amount of alcohol can affect your ability to ride safely.

questions.question: When choosing shoes for riding, you should pick:

options.text: Shoes with long heels.
Shoes with long laces that hang loose.
Shoes that cover your ankles.
Shoes made from thin materials.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shoes that cover your ankles.
questions.explanation: Wear boots or shoes that are high and sturdy to cover and support your ankles. Heels should be short so they don't catch on things. Laces should be tucked in so they don't catch on the motorcycle's moving parts.

questions.question: Which type of sign is yellow with black letters or symbols?

options.text: Warning
Service
Regulatory
Speed limit

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards.

questions.question: Smoothly downshifting on a motorcycle:

options.text: Is a waste of time.
Can help you slow down using engine braking.
Is against the law.
Should not be done when other vehicles are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can help you slow down using engine braking.
questions.explanation: Smoothly downshifting lets you use engine braking to slow down. When you do this, use your brake lights separately so other drivers know you are slowing down.
